nodes.title: Two-phase chat flow
nodes.summary: Split the chat into two phases: phase one defines the boundaries of the document, and phase two captures the context needed for the final document generation. This helps the AI understand when the cycle is complete.

nodes.title: JSON checklist to track completion
nodes.summary: Once phase one is complete, send a JSON checklist to the AI. Each time the user responds, any checklist item their response satisfies is updated, and when all items are satisfied the final document-generation step runs.

nodes.title: Persist data across sessions with IndexedDB
nodes.summary: Add data persistence across sessions by using IndexedDB, so the chat state is retained between sessions.
